name: Riho
source:
A recurring character who appeared in a number of D3 games. In this continuity Riho is a gravure idol who has made several appearances in TV dramas and is on the verge of her big break; an upcoming role in a movie. Her character in this big project is a hostess, and in Riho's mind, what better way to get into the character than to experience the job for real? She's cheerful and energetic and ties to take care of her figure, she can give the impression of being an airhead at times, but is actually rather perceptive and good at dodging uncomfortable situations.

[spoiler]Her full name is Futaba Riho (双葉 理保).[/spoiler]
